"""Record focused public-gate checks, without altering tests or settings."""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FILES = (
    "src/axiom_encode/harness/source_completeness.py",
    "src/axiom_encode/harness/manual_locator_metadata.py",
    "src/axiom_encode/harness/validator_pipeline.py",
    "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py",
)


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


frozen = {name: digest(name) for name in FILES}
environment = dict(os.environ)
for name in (
    "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
    "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS",
):
    environment[name] = "1"
environment["OMP_WAIT_POLICY"] = "PASSIVE"
environment["UV_CACHE_DIR"] = os.environ["UV_CACHE_DIR"]
environment["HYPOTHESIS_STORAGE_DIRECTORY"] = str(BASE / "hypothesis-current")


def run(name, selection, timeout=7200):
    temp = Path(os.environ["PYTEST_BASETEMP_PREFIX"] + name)
    command = [
        ".venv/bin/pytest", "-q", "-o", "addopts=", "--no-cov",
        "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--basetemp=" + str(temp), *selection,
    ]
    log = BASE / (name + ".log")
    started = time.monotonic()
    print("START", name, flush=True)
    with log.open("w") as output:
        output.write("COMMAND " + repr(command) + "\n")
        output.flush()
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command, env=environment, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT
        )
        (BASE / (name + ".pid")).write_text(str(process.pid) + "\n")
        try:
            code = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=15)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
            code = 124
        elapsed = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
        output.write(f"\nWRAPPER exit {code}, elapsed {elapsed}s\n")
    shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)
    changed = {name: digest(name) for name in FILES} != frozen
    summary = re.findall(r"[^\n]*\b(?:passed|failed|deselected)\b[^\n]*", log.read_text())
    result = {
        "command": command, "exit_code": code,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "summary": summary[-1:] or [],
        "validated_file_sha256": frozen,
        "files_changed_during_run": changed,
        "log_sha256": digest(log),
    }
    if "old_complete_plugin" in selection:
        result["runtime_review_head_sha256"] = {
            name: digest(Path(".hub-scratch/r6") / snapshot)
            for name, snapshot in (
                (FILES[0], "source_completeness_old.py"),
                (FILES[1], "manual_locator_metadata_old.py"),
                (FILES[2], "pre_collision_validator.py"),
            )
        }
    (BASE / (name + "-result.json")).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("DONE", name, code, result["summary"], flush=True)
    return result


mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == "generated":
    collection = (BASE / "collection.log").read_text()
    nodes = [line for line in collection.splitlines() if line.startswith("tests/")]
    assert len(nodes) == 295, len(nodes)
    # Disjoint public pytest node arguments preserve every parametrization,
    # explicit example, and original Hypothesis setting.
    shards = [(f"generated-{index + 1}", nodes[index::4]) for index in range(4)]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
        results = list(executor.map(lambda shard: run(*shard), shards))
elif mode == "dependent":
    focus = [f"tests/test_source_completeness_{name}.py" for name in (
        "locator_masks", "manual_mask_operative_values", "manual_mask_review_headings",
        "manual_mask_review_stamps", "locator_replays", "us_manual_numeric_recall",
        "manual_typography",
    )]
    numeric = (
        "typed_numeric_occurrences or numeric_profile_convention_matrix or "
        "legacy_percentage_context or legacy_profile_keeps_uk_single_dot_dual_read or "
        "numeric_extraction_reads_single_dot_group_as_decimal_too or "
        "grounding_accepts_european or grounding_accepts_spaced_european or "
        "grounding_accepts_dot_thousands or grounding_accepts_spaced_thousands or "
        "numeric_extraction_handles_ghana_cedi_grouped_thousands"
    )
    checks = [
        ("focused", focus),
        ("complete-source", ["tests/test_source_completeness.py", "-k",
            "us_manual or numbered_manual or leading_values or locator_masks"]),
        ("numeric", ["tests/test_rulespec_validation.py", "-k", numeric]),
        ("upstream-controls", [
            ".hub-scratch/r6/main-integration/test_upstream_manual_controls.py"
        ]),
    ]
    results = [run(*check) for check in checks]
elif mode == "old-generated":
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = ".hub-scratch/r6:src"
    environment["HYPOTHESIS_STORAGE_DIRECTORY"] = str(BASE / "hypothesis-old")
    results = [run("old-generated", [
        "-p", "old_mask_plugin",
        "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py::"
        "test_generated_monetary_caption_and_column_qualifiers_keep_every_value"
        "[parentheses-Fees in dollars]",
        "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py::"
        "test_generated_referenced_stamp_date_survives_every_source_shape"
        "[preceding-The month shown below determines eligibility.]",
    ])]
elif mode == "old-exact":
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = ".hub-scratch/r6-resumed/tests:src"
    environment["HYPOTHESIS_STORAGE_DIRECTORY"] = str(BASE / "hypothesis-old-exact")
    results = [run("old-exact", [
        "-p", "old_complete_plugin",
        "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py::"
        "test_round_five_operative_values_are_demanded",
        "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py::"
        "test_generated_monetary_caption_and_column_qualifiers_keep_every_value"
        "[parentheses-Fees in dollars]",
        "tests/test_source_completeness_manual_mask_fail_safe.py::"
        "test_generated_referenced_stamp_date_survives_every_source_shape"
        "[preceding-The month shown below determines eligibility.]",
    ])]
else:
    raise SystemExit(mode)

(BASE / (mode + "-results.json")).write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")
raise SystemExit(0 if all(not result["exit_code"] and not result["files_changed_during_run"] for result in results) else 1)
